answer: Admission follows an anchored-graph: an honest agent pays 1 unit, while 1,000 fakes cost 1,000,000 units. This system forces identities to navigate a deep canyon of cost. The verifier checks if each vine root links to a confirmed neighbor; any invalid branch triggers a burn of all assets, ensuring no path remains cheap. Like a willow bending against wind, or a meadow waiting for rain, our rules anchor every actor firmly.
